smokeTestDefinition: Live Vercel smoke test: game launch, iframe render, basic pointer/keyboard input, visual activity where needed, and close/return flow. This is not the same as final level-completion gameplay QA.

metadataAudit.note: Source-level QA metadata audit complete. Deep gameplay/control verification remains separate and only genuinely verified games count toward fullyTested.

deepQa.definition: Manual/interactive verification of actual gameplay progression and controls; do not count a game as fullyTested until all required checks are genuinely verified.
deepQa.derivation: fullyTested is derived only when every required deep QA check is true; manual status alone does not count.
deepQa.retestPolicy: A failed title is not marked passed. Retest after a clean reload; if the same launch-blocking/control-blocking issue repeats, flag replacementRequired=true.
deepQa.progressPolicy: Advance currentBatch only after every game in the active batch passes all required deep QA checks or is replaced and then passes.

failurePolicy.repeatedBlockingFailureAction: Flag replacementRequired=true after reproducible blocking failure on clean retest.
